newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Israel's embassy in Portugal gets bomb hoax.
newsitem.headline: Israel's embassy in Portugal gets bomb hoax.

text.p: Explosives experts searched Israel's embassy in Portugal on Monday after what turned out to be a bomb hoax coinciding with Israel's Independence Day celebrations, a police spokesman said.
"There was a threat. A bomb detection squad of the Public Security Police (PSP) went to the embassy and have since left after finding nothing," the spokesman told Reuters.
Officials at the embassy were not available as Monday was a holiday marking 49 years since Israel declared its independence.
